content:
sarah: Quick heads-up — saw a spike in unassigned leads last night (~2.3k). Enrichment TTL backed up and round-robin claims stalled. Thinking we should add a short rate-limiter + a backstop claim job. low-risk, fast deploy? :thinking_face:
pradeep: ouch. timeline? was this HS webhook surge or SF sync lag?
nora: looks like enrichment delayed ~45-90s for a lot of contacts; hubspot-bot logs show retries piling up. RR workers hit a deadlock on claim leases.
sarah: confirmed. HS webhook queue length jumped then the enrichment service fell behind (high mem GC). leads were sitting unowned >2m.
tim: proposal: 3 parts — 1) transient rate-limiter on inbound webhook (tunable, per-account) 2) short-lived backstop claim job that picks unowned leads older than X 3) adjust RR lease/heartbeat so workers don't grab and hang forever.
pradeep: +1. concrete numbers?
sarah: draft numbers: webhook rate-limit = 200 req/s global burst, per-account soft cap 20 rps; backstop job runs every 30s, picks leads unowned > 60s, claims up to 500 batch with exponential jitter; RR lease TTL shorten from 3m -> 75s and heartbeat interval 20s.
nora: sounds safe. backstop should skip leads that are "being enriched" flag true. we avoid racing enrichment writes to SF.
tim: agree. also add a kill-switch flag and metric: backstop_claims{result="stolen|ok|conflict"} and a gauge for unowned_count. will need alert if backstop picks >1000 leads in 10m.
sarah: good call. I'll draft a short runbook snippet and a tiny HubSpot workflow tweak: if enrichment fails for >3 attempts set property "needs_manual_review" = true and route to overflow queue.
pradeep: can we do a cheap gating rule in the webhook lambda instead of touching HubSpot? maybe 409 the request if backlog > threshold and let HS retry with metadata.
nora: HS retries are limited and opaque. i prefer throttling upstream + a visible HS property. ops can still backfill.
sarah: here's a quick config idea (pseudo):
```
inbound_rate_limiter:
  global_rps: 200
  per_account_rps: 20
backstop_claim:
  interval_s: 30
  min_age_s: 60
  batch_size: 500
rr_leases:
  ttl_s: 75
  heartbeat_s: 20
```
pradeep: nice. effort estimate?
tim: eng-infra + eng-sre pair for the lambda changes + add metric + runbook — 1 day for a small canary rollout, 2-3 days for QA + HS workflow.
sarah: i'll draft the marketing-safe blurb for sales: "improves lead handoff reliability under spikes; reduces unowned leads and routing jitter."
nora: one edge: international bursts from partners in APAC might hit per-account cap; can we make caps region-aware?
pradeep: region-aware is optional for phase 1. add as follow-up if we see false positives in canary.
sarah: action items: 1) pradeep — prototype rate-limiter lambda (canary) 2) tim — create backstop job skeleton + metrics 3) nora — HS workflow property and runbook text 4) sarah — communicate to sales & ops and prepare rollback notes. I'll open tickets and ping folks.
pradeep: on it. ETA EOD tomorrow for prototype.
tim: creating WIP branch now. will add prometheus metrics and test harness.
nora: i'll model the HS property and a small workflow; will coordinate with support to watch the overflow queue.
sarah: thanks all. we'll sync in #marketing-ops tomorrow 9:30 PT for canary play. :rocket:
